assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq 6000), bilateral dentate gyrus, 12-month-old male C57BL/6 p16Ink4a WT and KO mice
design: 2x2 factorial, n = 4 independent mice per group (S2.10.p1), 16 samples
sample_inclusion: all 16 deposited samples; no exclusions stated
primary_estimand: effect of 12 days of voluntary running on dentate gyrus gene expression in aged p16 KO mice (Set A, KO RUN vs KO CTL) and how it differs from WT (genotype x running interaction, GLM/LRT); running in WT (Set C) is the WT exercise effect
planned_contrasts: Set A: KO RUN vs KO CTL (S3.1.p4; paper: 3,272 genes p<0.05)
Set B: KO CTL vs WT CTL (S3.1.p4; paper: 1,230 genes p<0.05) - genotype, not exercise
Set C: WT RUN vs WT CTL (S3.1.p4; paper: 762 genes p<0.05)
Set D: KO RUN vs WT CTL (S3.1.p4; paper: 1,475 genes p<0.05)
Set E: KO RUN vs WT RUN (S3.1.p4; paper: 494 genes p<0.05)
GLM LRT genotype x treatment interaction (S2.5.p5, S3.4.1.p1; paper: 866 genes p<0.05)
paper_method: htseq-count reads -> DESeq2 Wald test per pairwise comparison; DESeq2 LRT full (genotype + treatment + interaction) vs reduced (no interaction) for the GLM set (S2.5.p4, S2.5.p5, S2.10.p1)
paper_results: Set A 3272, Set B 1230, Set C 762, Set D 1475, Set E 494, GLM interaction 866; Set A_Set E_GLM 106 genes; Set D_Set E_GLM 29 genes; qPCR-validated: Tfap2c, Lepr, Top2a, Slc18a2, Lpin2, Rgs14, Ramp3, Chrm5
